notes.title: Introducing the New Moons Economy
notes.content:
[url=https://www.linkedin.com/posts/digital-nomad-entertainment_newmoons-newmoonseconomy-ugc-activity-7282757969203597312-LUil?utm_source=combined_share_message&utm_medium=member_desktop_web][img]https://media.licdn.com/dms/image/v2/D4D22AQEr8v7Rjxo21g/feedshare-shrink_2048_1536/B4DZREIQZkG0Ao-/0/1736309807064?e=1739404800&v=beta&t=nhX2CfStxrQM26d6wUvQfAHtV-AqCBaSdMc2cS05884[/img][/url]

We’re excited to announce a game-changing feature in New Moons! The New Moons Economy will soon empower players to create, share, and monetize their own content, all while benefiting from the industry-leading 50% revenue share.

This new system allows creators to shape the New Moons universe while enjoying real rewards for their innovative contributions.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/2a4Gl30.png[/img]

[h3]What You Can Create in the New Moons Economy:[/h3]

🗺️ Custom Maps & Levels
🌌 Unique Game Modes
🚀 Spaceships, Vehicles and Weapons
🗼 Buildings, Spaceports & Facilities
👾 Characters & Faction items
🎨 Skins, Animations, and Props
🌟 And Much More!

[h3]50% Revenue Share – The Best in the Industry[/h3]

Creators in the New Moons Economy will retain 50% of the revenue from their content sales. Whether you’re designing maps, creating characters, or crafting game modes, we believe your creativity should be rewarded. This 50% revenue share is one of the most generous in the industry, ensuring that creators are compensated fairly for their work.

[h3]Community Contests & Recognition[/h3]

Join UGC contests and showcase your talent to the New Moons community. Win exclusive rewards, recognition, and even earn a spot as one of the top creators in the galaxy.

[h3]Coming Soon[/h3]

🎮 UGC Tools: Easy-to-use creation tools for every skill level.
🛠️ Marketplace: A powerful platform for creators to publish, share, and monetize their content.
📚 Guides & Tutorials: Step-by-step resources to help you get started.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/2a4Gl30.png[/img]

[h3]What Will You Create First?[/h3]

We’re excited to see what you’ll bring to the New Moons Economy. Let us know in the comments what your first creation will be!

📥 Stay tuned for more updates on the launch of New Moons Economy and how you can get started. [url=https://discord.gg/Ut3g9fmq3N]Join our Discord[/url] today!

notes.title: Patch Notes: Alpha Version 1.4
notes.content:
[h2]Welcome to the New Moons Closed Alpha Version 1.4![/h2]

This update delivers significant improvements across gameplay mechanics, visuals, and audio, alongside refinements in level design and weapon systems. Here’s what’s new:

[h3]Closed Alpha Status[/h3]
New Moons continues its journey in Closed Alpha, focusing on enhancing core systems, incorporating player feedback, and preparing for the Closed Beta.

Don’t forget to wishlist New Moons on Steam for exclusive rewards and updates!

[h3]Level Design Updates[/h3]

[b]AlienLab Level (Multiplayer FFA):[/b]
Added additional spawn points to improve player distribution and balance.
Introduced a new dark portal aesthetic inspired by Diablo/Warcraft references for the rift gate area.

[b]Spaceship Level (Campaign Mode):[/b]
Updated the ship’s garage and lab areas with refined meshes, textures, and environmental updates.
Improved lighting and adjusted collision settings to enhance exploration.

[h3]Gameplay Enhancements[/h3]

[b]Railgun:[/b]
High-resolution textures added to particle effects with varying fading rates.
Introduced a new center core effect to the railgun beam for added visual impact.

[b]Energy Blaster:[/b]
Transitioned to a full-auto fire rate for smoother combat.
Brightness of wall impact effects reduced for better clarity.

[b]Sniper Rifle:[/b]
Added zoom functionality and updated crosshairs for improved precision.

[b]Grenades:[/b]
Fully redesigned frag grenade effects:
Burn mark decals for ground explosions.
Enhanced fire and smoke effects with dynamic secondary simulations.
Added debris, heat distortion effects, and realistic lighting for explosions.

[h3]Animation and Material Refinements[/h3]
Adjusted weapon and commander master materials to include a fade-off effect when near the camera, enhancing player visibility in close encounters.
Improved animation transitions for smoother gameplay responsiveness.

[h3]Sound and Audio Updates[/h3]
Updated energy blaster sound cues based on feedback for a more immersive experience.
Balanced sniper and grenade explosion sounds for consistency across gameplay.

[h3]UI and Debugging Tools[/h3]
Enhanced weapon system UI with clearer debug visualizations for projectile and grenade trajectories.
Updated category attributes for better organization and ease of testing.

[h3]Miscellaneous Improvements[/h3]
Refined the skybox for a more immersive atmosphere.
Optimized projectile system debug properties—debug mode now deactivated by default.
Updated collision and scale settings for improved interaction with new cockpit and character panels.

[b]Thank You![/b]

Your feedback is invaluable to shaping the future of New Moons. Stay tuned for more updates and don’t forget to wishlist New Moons on Steam! 🚀

notes.title: Patch Notes: Alpha Version 1.3
notes.content:
Welcome to the New Moons Closed Alpha Version 1.3! This update features major enhancements to level design, sound, animations, UI, and gameplay mechanics, along with improvements powered by Unreal Engine 5.5. Here’s everything included:

[b]Closed Alpha Status[/b]

New Moons remains in its Closed Alpha phase, focusing on refining core systems, incorporating player feedback, and preparing for the upcoming Closed Beta.
Wishlist New Moons on Steam to secure exclusive rewards and follow our development journey!

[b]Level Design Updates[/b]

[b]AlienLab Level (Multiplayer FFA):[/b]

Enhanced verticality with new ledges and platforms for diverse combat strategies.
Added 5 new spawn points to improve player distribution and reduce spawn camping.
Improved lighting and environmental details for better map readability during high-action moments.
Adjusted cover placements to create a more balanced flow for Free-for-All matches.
Spaceship Level (Campaign Mode):

Redesigned bridge layout featuring a central starmap display and panoramic windows for an immersive galactic feel.
Added interactive elements on the spaceship's main deck to enhance player engagement.
Refined lighting and post-processing effects for a brighter, more cinematic atmosphere.
Adjusted enemy placement to create a smoother difficulty curve during exploration and combat sequences.

[b]Unreal Engine 5.5 Connectivity Update[/b]
Enhanced Multiplayer Stability:

Leveraged Unreal Engine 5.5’s connectivity tools for reduced latency and smoother online play.
Optimized server-client communication to ensure reliable multiplayer session stability.
Seamless Lobby Transitions:

Faster and more reliable transitions between lobbies and game sessions using UE5.5 networking tools.
Replication Enhancements:

Updated weapon and player replication systems for improved accuracy in real-time multiplayer environments.

[b]Sound Refinements[/b]

Balanced overall audio levels to ensure consistency across gameplay:
Shotgun Sound FX: Further reduced volume to match other weapon levels.
Sniper Rifle and Energy Blaster FX: Fine-tuned to enhance their distinct feel.

[b]New Sound Effects Added:[/b]

Jump Pads, Sniper Rifles, Shotguns, Energy Blasters, and default reload animations.
Refined audio cues for respawn events to improve immersion.
Animation Polishing
Polished key animations for smoother gameplay and visual consistency:
Reload animations now integrate with sound effects using anim notifies.
Improved transition animations for jumping and landing.
Adjusted weapon swap animations for faster response times.
Respawn Animation Updates: Smoothed ragdoll transitions during respawn sequences.

[b]UI Updates
Main Menu Overhaul:[/b]

Imported a new background for the Main Menu and Custom Match Screen to align with the game’s aesthetic.
Custom Match Screen Redesign:
Updated layout and styling for better readability and easier navigation.
Enhanced session rows to display clearer match details.

[b]In-Game HUD:[/b]

Added player health bars with dynamic changes based on damage.
Updated UI flow for health, ammo, and match timers to ensure clarity during gameplay.
Weapon Balancing
Rebalanced stats for all weapons to improve gameplay fairness and variety:
Shotguns: Reduced damage falloff at medium range and slightly increased spread for close-quarters effectiveness.
Sniper Rifles: Adjusted reload times for better pacing and reduced body shot damage to emphasize precision.
Energy Blasters: Increased projectile speed and decreased charge time for smoother combat flow.
Assault Rifles: Refined recoil patterns for a more consistent feel during sustained fire.
Rift Gate Portal Updates

[b]New Visual Variants:[/b]

Introduced light and dark rift gate portals, adding aesthetic variety to the gameplay experience.
Improved Scalability:

Rift gates can now be scaled and rotated without breaking particle systems, offering greater flexibility in map design.

[b]Portal Blueprint Upgrades:[/b]

Adjusted portal effects to ensure smoother visual transitions and eliminate "popping" when viewed from specific angles.
Miscellaneous Improvements
Respawn FX Refinements:
Removed unnecessary hexagons and the green center effect.
Retained 10% of streak effects and 50% of white particles, scaled down by 50% for a cleaner look.

[b]Earthship Doors:[/b]
Adjusted door blueprints to open and close dynamically when approached by a Commander or Drone.

[b]Asteroid Field Updates:[/b]
Removed large asteroids, planets, and spherical asteroids for improved map clarity and performance.

Thank you for being part of the New Moons Closed Alpha! Your feedback is essential to shaping the game’s future. Don’t forget to wishlist New Moons on Steam to stay updated and secure your exclusive in-game rewards. 🚀
